etymology.historical_story: Helen is an English form of the ancient Greek personal name Helene. Its deeper etymology is uncertain, so familiar explanations involving light or a torch should remain proposals. Greek mythology and Christian naming traditions helped transmit the name across generations. Its occurrence in Malay discourse identifies a person rather than establishing a Malay common noun. [Source](https://www.behindthename.com/name/helen)
